title: PR: Add API Contract and Failure-Path Test Coverage (#3480)
head: dipanshubatra:feature/enterprise-tribal-indigenous-art-preservation-suite
body:
Summary
Introduces a comprehensive automated API test suite covering endpoint contracts, request validation, HTTP semantics, response schemas, authentication failures, and server-side error paths.

The tests are designed to verify both successful API behavior and deterministic failure handling across supported endpoints.

Changes
Added contract tests for successful API responses.
Added response schema and data-type validation.
Added request validation tests for required and optional parameters.
Added tests for missing required fields.
Added tests for unsupported and invalid data types.
Added malformed JSON payload tests.
Added invalid request parameter coverage.
Added tests for non-existent resources.
Added authentication and authorization failure scenarios.
Added server-side exception tests using mocked failures.
Added assertions for controlled and predictable error responses.
Verified that unexpected internal details are not exposed through API responses.

Test Scenarios
Successful Contract Validation
Verify valid requests return the expected HTTP status.
Validate required response fields.
Validate response field data types.
Ensure response structures remain consistent with the endpoint contract.

Request Validation
Missing required parameters.
Missing required request body fields.
Unsupported data types.
Invalid parameter formats.
Empty or invalid values.
Malformed JSON payloads.

HTTP Semantics
Verify appropriate 2xx responses for successful operations.
Verify 400 responses for invalid client requests.
Verify 401 responses for unauthenticated requests.
Verify 403 responses for unauthorized operations.
Verify 404 responses for missing resources.
Verify 500 responses for unexpected server failures.

Failure-Path Testing
Mock internal service/database failures.
Verify exceptions are converted into controlled API responses.
Ensure sensitive exception details are not returned to clients.
Verify error responses contain predictable fields.
Ensure failure responses do not produce malformed or empty payloads.

Validation
Each test validates:
HTTP status code.
Response structure.
Required fields.
Field data types.
Error response consistency.
Behavior under invalid and unexpected inputs.

Expected Result
All covered endpoints should behave deterministically and conform to their defined API contracts across both successful and failure scenarios.

The new test suite should also make regressions in request validation, response schemas, authentication handling, and server-side error handling immediately detectable.
